snippet.title: The Lost Apartment - Trapped in the Lost Apartment | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
In The Lost Apartment, investigator Jeremy is on a mission to uncover the dark secrets behind a chilling crime scene, that took place at an apartment on the outskirts of the city. At first everything seems normal. But as the minutes turn into hours, the investigator realizes that there is no way out of the apartment. Jeremy has to navigate the huge house, avoiding the traps that were set to keep him locked up forever, find clues, solve puzzles, and stay alert of the creatures that lure inside.
